g.text: D13 (series Schottky, docs/standard.md section 3) is required: the ATtiny's PB1 is wired to SAO GPIO2 through R5, so the badge could push current into the cell through the chip.

g.desc: D13 (series Schottky, docs/standard.md section 3) is required: the ATtiny's PB1 is wired to SAO GPIO2 through R5, so the badge could push current into the cell through the chip.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the board. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell (through D13).

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the board. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell (through D13).

g.text: R5 (330 ohm) is the SAO spec's series resistor on a GPIO the add-on may drive. PB1 is the maker's button pin; the chip has no other spare pin (PB0, PB2, PB3, PB4 drive the LEDs, PB5 is reset).

g.desc: R5 (330 ohm) is the SAO spec's series resistor on a GPIO the add-on may drive. PB1 is the maker's button pin; the chip has no other spare pin (PB0, PB2, PB3, PB4 drive the LEDs, PB5 is reset).

g.text: JP1: the maker's six AVR ISP pads (bare copper). SW2: the maker's push button on PB1 (pressed = low).

g.desc: JP1: the maker's six AVR ISP pads (bare copper). SW2: the maker's push button on PB1 (pressed = low).

g.text: Resistors 330 ohm (maker: 150 ohm); a lit LED sees two in series: about 2.3 mA at 3.3 V, about 1.4 mA on the cell after D13. D1..D12 are on the FRONT where the maker had LED1..LED12.

g.desc: Resistors 330 ohm (maker: 150 ohm); a lit LED sees two in series: about 2.3 mA at 3.3 V, about 1.4 mA on the cell after D13. D1..D12 are on the FRONT where the maker had LED1..LED12.

g.text: Maker's circuit (davedarko, Eagle 2017, REV1): ATtiny85 charlieplexes 12 LEDs from PB0, PB2, PB3, PB4, each through its own resistor to one node (maker's nets N$9, N$11, N$12, N$2 = NODE_A..D).

g.desc: Maker's circuit (davedarko, Eagle 2017, REV1): ATtiny85 charlieplexes 12 LEDs from PB0, PB2, PB3, PB4, each through its own resistor to one node (maker's nets N$9, N$11, N$12, N$2 = NODE_A..D).
